1 #!/usr/bin/env python
2 """
3 The Jog Controller allows to easily command the robot manually. It means that you can use
4 mouse input, Leap Motion, Wii Controller or even Image processing to calculate determine
5 where the robot should go
6 This controller can be used :
7 - directly by using ROS Topic | ROS Low Level (see the file client_jog_interface_mouse.py which shows how to use
8 a mouse to control the robot)
9 - with Python ROS Wrapper | "Medium" Level
10 - through the TCP server | High Level
11 """

155  def __callback_send_jog_command_ik(self, msg):
156  # check if the learning mode is false and the robot is calibrated
157  self.__check_before_use_jog()
158 
159  shift_mode = msg.cmd
160  if shift_mode != self._shift_mode:
161  self._reset_last_pub()
162  self._shift_mode = shift_mode
163 
164  shift_command = list(msg.shift_values)
165  shift_command[:3] = [
166  min([v, math.copysign(self.__pose_translation_max, v)], key=abs) for v in shift_command[:3]
167  ]
168  shift_command[3:] = [min([v, math.copysign(self.__pose_rotation_max, v)], key=abs) for v in shift_command[3:]]
169 
170  if self._last_shift_values_cmd != msg.shift_values:
171  self._last_shift_values_cmd = msg.shift_values
172  self.__jog_errors_cpt = 0
173 
174  try:
175  success, potential_target_values = self._get_new_joints_w_ik(shift_command, msg.reference_frame)
176  except ArmCommanderException as e:
177  return self.__publish_jog_error(e.status, "Error while validating pose : {}".format(e.message))
178  if not success:
179  return self.__publish_jog_error(
180  CommandStatus.NO_PLAN_AVAILABLE,
181  "Unable to find an invert kinematics for the target position",
182  )
183 
184  success, message = self.__validate_ik_joints(potential_target_values)
185  return self.__publish_jog_error(
186  CommandStatus.SUCCESS if success else CommandStatus.JOG_CONTROLLER_FAILURE,
187  message,
188  )

190  def __publish_jog_error(self, status, message):

198  def __callback_send_jog_joints_command(self, msg):
199  # check if the learning mode is false and the robot is calibrated
200  self.__check_before_use_jog()
201 
202  shift_mode = msg.cmd
203  if shift_mode != self._shift_mode:
204  self._reset_last_pub()
205  self._shift_mode = shift_mode
206 
207  if self._last_shift_values_cmd != msg.shift_values:
208  self._last_shift_values_cmd = msg.shift_values
209  self.__jog_errors_cpt = 0
210 
211  shift_command = list(msg.shift_values)
212  if shift_mode == JogShiftRequest.JOINTS_SHIFT:
213  # Accumulate multiple commands if they come faster than the publish rate
214  shift_command = [min([v, math.copysign(self.__joints_rotation_max, v)], key=abs) for v in shift_command]
215  target_values = [actual + shift for actual, shift in zip(self._last_target_values, shift_command)]
216 
217  # get index of the jogged joints in a list
218  joints_to_jog = [i for i, value in enumerate(shift_command) if value != 0]
219 
220  target_values = self.__limit_params_joints(target_values)
221 
222  try:
223  self.__validate_params_joints(target_values) # validate joints according to joints limits
224  except ArmCommanderException as e:
225  message = "Jog Controller - Error while validating joint : {}".format(e.message)
226  rospy.logwarn_throttle(1, message)
227  return self.__publish_jog_error(CommandStatus.JOG_CONTROLLER_FAILURE, message)
228 
229  # validate target joints validity, based on collisions checking
230  try:
231  valid, link_colliding1, link_colliding2 = (self.__check_joint_validity_moveit(target_values))
232  if not valid:
233  return self.__publish_jog_error(
234  CommandStatus.JOG_CONTROLLER_FAILURE,
235  "Joints target unreachable because of collision between {} and {}".format(
236  link_colliding1, link_colliding2),
237  )
238  except rospy.ServiceException as e:
239  message = "Jog Controller - Error while validating joint : {}".format(e.message)
240  rospy.logwarn_throttle(1, message)
241  return self.__publish_jog_error(CommandStatus.JOG_CONTROLLER_FAILURE, message)
242 
243  if self.__collision_detected:
244  return self.__publish_jog_error(CommandStatus.JOG_CONTROLLER_FAILURE, "Collision detected")
245 
246  self.set_target_values(target_values)
247  self._current_jogged_joints = joints_to_jog
248  self._new_robot_state = RobotState()
249  return self.__publish_jog_error(CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Success")
250 
251  def __callback_joint_controller_state(self, msg):
252  # check if collision when jogging joints
253  current_joints_error = msg.error.positions
254 
255  # this error tolerance is lower than the one in arm_commander bc the jog is much slower
256  for error, tolerance in zip(current_joints_error, self.__error_tolerance_joint):
257  if (abs(error) > tolerance and self._enabled and self._shift_mode == JogShiftRequest.JOINTS_SHIFT):
258  self.__collision_detected = True
259  self.__arm_state.set_learning_mode(True)
260  abort_str = ("Command has been aborted due to a collision or "
261  "a motor not able to follow the given trajectory")
262  rospy.logwarn(abort_str)
263  self.disable()
264  rospy.sleep(1) # sleep so if the arrow in NS is still pressed, the jog wont re-start directly.
265  return
266 
267  self.__collision_detected = False
268 
269  def __callback_jog_commander(self, msg):
270  # check if the learning mode is false and the robot is calibrated
271  self.__check_before_use_jog()
272 
273  shift_mode = msg.cmd
274  if shift_mode != self._shift_mode:
275  self._reset_last_pub()
276  self._shift_mode = shift_mode
277 
278  shift_command = list(msg.shift_values)
279  if shift_mode == JogShiftRequest.POSE_SHIFT:
280  shift_command[:3] = [
281  min([v, math.copysign(self.__pose_translation_max, v)], key=abs) for v in shift_command[:3]
282  ]
283  shift_command[3:] = [
284  min([v, math.copysign(self.__pose_rotation_max, v)], key=abs) for v in shift_command[3:]
285  ]
286  try:
287  success, potential_target_values = self._get_new_joints_w_ik(shift_command, msg.reference_frame)
288  except ArmCommanderException as e:
289  return e.status, "Error while validating pose : {}".format(e.message)
290  if not success:
291  return (
292  CommandStatus.NO_PLAN_AVAILABLE,
293  "Unable to find on invert kinematics for the target position",
294  )
295  else:
296  self.set_target_values(potential_target_values)
297  else:
298  # Accumulate multiple commands if they come faster than the publish rate
299  shift_command = [min([v, math.copysign(self.__joints_rotation_max, v)], key=abs) for v in shift_command]
300  target_values = [actual + shift for actual, shift in zip(self._last_target_values, shift_command)]
301 
302  target_values = self.__limit_params_joints(target_values)
303 
304  joints_to_jog = [i for i, value in enumerate(shift_command) if value != 0]
305 
306  try:
307  self.__validate_params_joints(target_values) # validate joints according to joints limits
308  except ArmCommanderException as e:
309  return e.status, "Error while validating joints : {}".format(e.message)
310 
311  # validate target joints validity, based on collisions checking
312  try:
313  valid, link_colliding1, link_colliding2 = (self.__check_joint_validity_moveit(target_values))
314  if not valid:
315  if link_colliding1 is not None and link_colliding2 is not None:
316  return (
317  CommandStatus.JOG_CONTROLLER_FAILURE,
318  "Joints target unreachable because of collision between {} and {}".format(

322  return (

326  except rospy.ServiceException as e:
327  return e, "Error while validating joint : {}".format(e.message)
328 
329  self._current_jogged_joints = joints_to_jog

336  def _publish_jog_enabled(self, *_):
337  msg = Bool()
338  msg.data = self._enabled

344  def _publish_joint_trajectory(self, *_):
345  if not self._enabled:
346  return
347 
348  target_values = self.get_target_values()
349  if not target_values:
350  return
351  msg = JointTrajectory()
352  msg.header.stamp = rospy.Time(0)
353 
354  point = JointTrajectoryPoint()
355 
356  if self._shift_mode == JogShiftRequest.JOINTS_SHIFT:
357  # if jogging joint, we send a command with only one joint,
358  # thanks to the allow_partial_joints_goal parameter,
359  # so the other joints are not affected by the jog.
360  joint_names = []
361  positions = []
362 
363  for elem in self._current_jogged_joints:
364  joint_names.append("joint_{}".format(elem + 1))
365  positions.append(target_values[elem])
366 
367  msg.joint_names = joint_names
368  point.positions = positions
369 
370  else:
371  msg.joint_names = self.__arm_state.joints_name
372  point.positions = target_values
373  point.time_from_start = rospy.Duration(self._timer_rate)
374  msg.points = [point]
375 
376  try:
377  self._joint_trajectory_publisher.publish(msg)
378  except rospy.ROSSerializationException:
379  rospy.logerr(target_values)
380  rospy.logerr(msg)
381 
382  # Reset Target
383  self.set_target_values(None)
384  self._current_jogged_joints = None
385 
386  # Save state for next time
387  self._last_target_values = target_values
388  self._last_robot_state_published = self._new_robot_state
389

485  def _check_for_disable(self, *_):
486  if not self.is_enabled():

492  def _reset_last_pub(self):
493  self._last_target_values = self.__arm_state.joint_states
494  self._last_robot_state_published = self.__arm_state.robot_state
495  self.__jog_errors_cpt = 0
496 
497  def _get_new_joints_w_ik(self, shift_command, reference_frame="world"):
498  if not reference_frame:
499  reference_frame = "world"
500 
501  if not hasattr(self, 'tf_listener') or not hasattr(self, 'tf_buffer'):
502  self.tf_buffer = tf2_ros.Buffer()
503  self.tf_listener = tf2_ros.TransformListener(self.tf_buffer)
504 
505  self._new_robot_state = RobotState()
506  last_pose = self._last_robot_state_published.position
507  last_ori = self._last_robot_state_published.orientation
508  current_quat = [last_ori.x, last_ori.y, last_ori.z, last_ori.w]
509 
510  if reference_frame == "world":
511  self._new_robot_state.position.x = last_pose.x + shift_command[0]
512  self._new_robot_state.position.y = last_pose.y + shift_command[1]
513  self._new_robot_state.position.z = last_pose.z + shift_command[2]
514  else:
515  self._new_robot_state.position = self._calc_relative_translation(last_pose, shift_command, reference_frame)
516  new_quat = self._calc_new_rotation(current_quat, shift_command, is_world=(reference_frame == "world"))
517 
518  if new_quat is not None:
519  self._new_robot_state.orientation = Quaternion(*new_quat)
520  self._new_robot_state.rpy = RPY(*euler_from_quaternion(new_quat))
521  else:
522  # Bypass quaternion math on pure translation to avoid Euler angle wrap-around
523  self._new_robot_state.orientation = last_ori
524  self._new_robot_state.rpy = self._last_robot_state_published.rpy
525 
526  self.__validate_params_pose(self._new_robot_state)
527 
528  success, joints = self.__kinematics_handler.get_inverse_kinematics(
529  Pose(self._new_robot_state.position, self._new_robot_state.orientation)
530  )
531  return success, joints
532 
533  def _calc_relative_translation(self, last_pose, shift_command, reference_frame):
534 
535  local_pose = Pose()
536  local_pose.position.x = shift_command[0]
537  local_pose.position.y = shift_command[1]
538  local_pose.position.z = shift_command[2]
539  local_pose.orientation.w = 1.0
540 
541  pose_stamped = tf2_geometry_msgs.PoseStamped()
542  pose_stamped.pose = local_pose
543  pose_stamped.header.stamp = rospy.Time.now()
544 
545  if reference_frame == "TCP":
546  active_transform = self.tf_buffer.lookup_transform("world", "TCP", rospy.Time(0), rospy.Duration(1.0))
547  pose_stamped.header.frame_id = "TCP"
548  else:
549  custom_transform = self.tf_buffer.lookup_transform("world",
550  reference_frame,
551  rospy.Time(0),
552  rospy.Duration(1.0))
553  active_transform = TransformStamped()
554  active_transform.header.frame_id = "world"
555  active_transform.child_frame_id = "virtual_TCP"
556  active_transform.transform.translation.x = last_pose.x
557  active_transform.transform.translation.y = last_pose.y
558  active_transform.transform.translation.z = last_pose.z
559  active_transform.transform.rotation = custom_transform.transform.rotation
560  pose_stamped.header.frame_id = "virtual_TCP"
561 
562  transform_pose = tf2_geometry_msgs.do_transform_pose(pose_stamped, active_transform)
563  return transform_pose.pose.position
564 
565  def _calc_new_rotation(self, current_quat, shift_command, is_world):
566 
567  is_pure_translation = all(abs(cmd) < 0.0001 for cmd in shift_command[3:6])
568  if is_pure_translation:
569  return None
570 
571  quat_jog = quaternion_from_euler(shift_command[3], shift_command[4], shift_command[5])
572 
573  if is_world:
574  quat_target = quaternion_multiply(quat_jog, current_quat)
575  else:
576  quat_target = quaternion_multiply(current_quat, quat_jog)
577 
578  return quat_target / np.linalg.norm(quat_target)
579 
580  def __validate_params_pose(self, new_robot_state):
581  self.__parameters_validator.validate_position(new_robot_state.position)
582  self.__parameters_validator.validate_orientation(new_robot_state.rpy)
583 
584  def __validate_params_joints(self, joints):
585  self.__parameters_validator.validate_joints(joints)
586 
587  def __check_joint_validity_moveit(self, joints):
588  """
589  Check target joint validity (no collision) with MoveIt.
590  :return: The target joint validity in a boolean, and the two links colliding if available
591  """
592  robot_state_target = RobotStateMoveIt()
593  robot_state_target.joint_state.header.frame_id = "world"
594  robot_state_target.joint_state.position = joints
595  robot_state_target.joint_state.name = self.__arm_state.joints_name
596  group_name = self.__arm.get_name()
597  null_constraints = Constraints()
598  try:
599  response = self.__parameters_validator.check_state_validity(robot_state_target,
600  group_name,
601  null_constraints)
602  if not response.valid:
603  if len(response.contacts) > 0:
604  rospy.logwarn(
605  "Jog Controller - Joints target unreachable because of collision between %s and %s",
606  response.contacts[0].contact_body_1,
607  response.contacts[0].contact_body_2,
608  )
609  return (
610  False,
611  response.contacts[0].contact_body_1,
612  response.contacts[0].contact_body_2,
613  )
614  else: # didn't succeed to get the contacts on the real robot
615  rospy.logwarn_throttle(
616  1,
617  "Jog Controller - Joints target unreachable because of "
618  "collision between two parts of Ned",
619  )
620  return False, None, None
621  else:
622  return True, None, None
623 
624  except AttributeError as _e: # maybe delete later, useful for the test on real robot when using the service
625  return True, None, None

627  def __limit_params_joints(self, joints):
628  joints_limits = self.__parameters_validator.get_joints_limits()
629  for j, joint_value in enumerate(joints):
630  joints[j] = max(joints_limits[j].lower, min(joints_limits[j].upper, joint_value))
631  return joints
632 
633  def __validate_ik_joints(self, joints):
634  """
635  Check if the list of joints values received from the inverse kinematic is usable.
636  If a joint is bigger than 0.5 radian the list becomes None and a warning appears
637 
638  :return: List with the values from the inverse kinematic or None if the movement is too complicated
639  :rtype: list
640  """
641 
642  actual_joints = list(self.__arm_state.joint_states)
643  for i in range(len(joints)):
644  if abs(actual_joints[i] - joints[i]) > 0.5:
645  error_str = "Jog Controller can't execute this command: {}".format(
646  [round(joint, 3) for joint in joints])
647  rospy.logwarn_throttle(0.5, error_str)
648  self.set_target_values(None)
649  self._current_jogged_joints = None
650  return (
651  False,
652  "Unable to find an invert kinematics for the target position "
653  "close enough to the current position",
654  )
655  else:
656  self.set_target_values(joints)
657  return True, "Success"
658 
659  def __check_before_use_jog(self):
660  """
661  Check if the calibration has already been done on the robot and if the learning mode is off.
662 
663  :return: None
664  :rtype: None
665  """
666  hdw_st = self.__arm_state.hardware_status
667  if hdw_st.calibration_needed or hdw_st.calibration_in_progress:
668  return (
669  CommandStatus.ABORTED,
670  "Cannot send command cause Jog because calibration is not done",
671  )
672 
673  if self.__arm_state.learning_mode_on:
674  try:
675  self.__arm_state.set_learning_mode(False)
676  rospy.sleep(0.1)
677  except (rospy.ROSException, rospy.ServiceException):
678  return (
679  CommandStatus.ABORTED,
680  "Error while trying to turn Off learning mode",
681  )
682 
683  if not self._enabled:
684  ret, str_msg = self.enable()
685  if ret == CommandStatus.ABORTED:
686  return (
687  CommandStatus.ABORTED,
688  "Cannot send command cause Jog is not activated and cannot be",
689  )
690  self._last_command_timer = rospy.get_time()
691 
692 
693 if __name__ == "__main__":
694  pass
